designRuling.reason: The complete existing three-choice policy can be surfaced before first Advance without a new atrocity mechanic, target selector, or metric, but retained evidence proves two immediate territorial captures can follow always_allow, so unanimous section 6 review remains mandatory.

conditions.requirement: Queue exactly one existing rbih_paramilitary_policy_1992 decision only after a successful turn-0 RBiH identity receipt and before first Advance; keep Advance hard-blocked until response; fail closed for observer/headless, non-RBiH, later-turn, disabled, fired, closed, pending, and already-decided states.

Render all three authored options in authored order with complete existing disclosure and historical/counterfactual context; do not preselect, auto-resolve, or infer a choice from Historical mode; keep policy ask until explicit response.

Use the existing event resolver and canonical persistence/receipt path; prohibit direct policy assignment, synthetic requests, direct spawn/control writes, duplicate queueing, duplicate effects, and duplicate receipts.

Move the complete event consequences together, including flags, dimensions, modifiers, notifications, receipt provenance, civilian casualties, and war-crime accounting; any split or reduced cost voids this verdict.

Add no target selector, brutality scale, specialized atrocity doctrine, casualty-to-territory comparison, risk/reward tooltip, score incentive, achievement, or territorial-efficiency/calibration-reward framing.

Preserve always_deny as the historical default and ask/always_allow as counterfactual; label any always_allow measurement counterfactual; leave event data, headless/bot behavior, and historical default unchanged.

Limit causal claims to proven pre-first-Advance capability and exact immediate effects; do not infer all seven January differences, tune/adopt scores, change thresholds or protected controls, or modify n91-n95/all telemetry.
Before implementation, obtain separate UI/UX review and unanimous Historian, scenario-tester/calibration, Engine/systems, and Red-team GO; any BLOCK, split, or unmet condition returns to the owner.

causalBoundary.proven: Two immediate turn-1 RBiH paramilitary captures differ between the retained no-player n94 lane and the ordinary player lane.
causalBoundary.notProven: The timing difference causes all seven later January control differences or satisfies any calibration floor.

preserve: sweep, threshold, capture, and scoring semantics
